name: Museum of Lost Gestures
description: Recover ten lost gestures by exploring the gallery observation room.
natural_language: Recover the ten lost gestures, then close the exhibition. All gestures belong inside the gallery room; use its corner to resize it. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage. Do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console, debugger, inspector, network, source, DOM or page-state inspection, terminal, shell, Python, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload/navigation, browser extensions, external applications, or any implementation or hidden-state access. Do not switch to or interact with unrelated, pre-existing, blank, or browser-settings tabs. Task-opened tabs are allowed only when part of the task and only through their visible controls.

metadata.notes: Original bounded-room event gallery. Candidate only; no human or agent calibration.
